messages:
Iris L.: Short ask: pilot customer raised a corner case: long-lived chat sessions that hold KV cache cause preempt to be much more disruptive than single-request spikes. need product decision: treat long-lived sessions differently for bursting/credits?
Ben K.: Good catch. proposal: classify sessions by session_type: ephemeral vs persistent. persistent sessions get soft-grace (extend drain to 300s) but consume from a persistent_session_band not the regular burst band.
Sam R.: Implementation note: runtime already tags sessions with duration_estimate. We can set persistent if duration_estimate > 15m or has websocket handle. Adding a separate accounting bucket is doable but touches admission controller + billing.
Tara (ops): Ops: longer drains increase eviction surface. we should require a per-tenant limit on concurrent persistent sessions in Dedicated pools to prevent abuse. also need telemetry: persistent_drain_count and persistent_eviction_latency.
Legal - Mei: Commercial point: extended drains mean longer resource hold. we must document that persistent_session_band is limited and not refundable if customer exceeds their purchased persistent allocation.
Iris L.: Proposed product rule: 1) persistent sessions allocated from a persistent pool (configurable per tenant) 2) persistent pool uses a small fixed cushion (e.g., 5% of commit) + optional paid add-on for larger persistent allowance 3) when pool exhausted, fallback to soft-preempt with 300s drain and reduced KV retention. credits only for involuntary drops, not for graceful drains.
Ben K.: Dev plan: add session_type tag, new persistent_pool accounting, and admission logic. low-risk roll: feature flag behind tenant opt-in.
Sam R.: Billing: persistent_pool usage billed as a separate SKU. if we allow temporary overcommit, mark spilled_persistent_tokens and only credit if requests actually failed (not drained). we'll need an idempotent event for persistent_eviction.
Tara (ops): Runbook addition: if persistent_eviction_rate > 0.2% for any tenant in 30m, page oncall and pause persistent admissions for that tenant. Also add a dashboard widget for persistent_pool pressure.
Legal - Mei: I'll draft contract language clarifying persistent allocation, drain behavior, and refund rules.
Iris L.: Launch checklist: 1) session tagging + feature flag 2) admission + persistent accounting 3) billing SKU + eviction events 4) telemetry + dashboards 5) pilot with 1 customer that uses long-lived sessions.
Ben K.: Timeline estimate: MVP behind FF in 2 sprints (session tagging + accounting + simple billing events). GA with UI + SKU in 4-5 sprints.
Sam R.: I'll prototype the billing event schema and simulate persistent spill behavior.
capacity-bot: Reminder: capacity roadmap sync Friday 10AM.
Iris L.: Thanks all. Action owners: @Ben implement FF PR, @Sam billing prototype, @Tara dashboard + runbook, @Mei contract blurb. We'll reconvene Thurs to review the PR. :white_check_mark:
